# persistent-draft

`useDraft` is the reactive `useState` drop-in; `readDraft`/`writeDraft` are the
render-free twin over the same key grammar, envelope and TTL, for callers writing
at input frequency (a scroll offset, a caret position) where a render per write
would be absurd. Reach for those rather than hand-rolling a second envelope.

## Plugin reference

- Description: Generic localStorage-backed persistence with optional entity scope and TTL auto-expiry: useDraft is the reactive useState drop-in (all calls on one key stay in sync within and across tabs); readDraft/writeDraft are the render-free imperative twin for callers writing at input frequency.
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `apps/sonata/library`
    - `apps/sonata/rich/chord-readout`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer/tool-call/ask-user-question`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/prompt-input`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/push-and-exit`
    - `primitives/auto-scroll`
    - `primitives/css/color-picker`
    - `primitives/detail-sections`
    - `primitives/usage-rank`
    - `shell/global-action-bar`
    - `tasks/task-draft-form`
- Web:
  - Exports (types): `DraftOptions`
  - Exports (values):
    - `clearDraft`
    - `DEFAULT_DRAFT_TTL`
    - `draftKey`
    - `readDraft`
    - `useDraft`
    - `writeDraft`
